baseline_selection: E20 only if its existing fixed 800-game gate promotes it; otherwise WDL25. Require its unit terminal before any new matches. This rule precedes consulting any e20 gate score.
instrument: ownedmatch_counterdraw.py plus unchanged ownedmatch.py and helpers. Fingerprint the separate wrapper, semantic checker and pinned chess 1.11.2 core. Retain raw trace hashes and independently validate every permitted Counter draw-PV diagnostic.
draw_exception: Exact Counter artifact only: recorded info and startpos history must match the diagnostic; every history/PV move must be legal; the warned move must be the first move after the independently drawn fifty-move or threefold boundary. No other warnings or illegal moves, including post-draw tails, are permitted.
control_requirements: Require exact-release synthetic draw reproduction, preserved raw-trace positive controls, adversarial negative fixtures and a new four-game procedure smoke before fresh scored games. Every gate requires a fresh exact-clock/concurrency/affinity A/A with this instrument.

matches.decision: Report the fully audited relative result and paired 95% uncertainty at exactly 400 games. No score-based extension or pooling with the rejected run. This single anchor cannot establish an official CCRL rating or by itself prove the full >3500 release goal.

admission: Wait for the e20 unit to be terminal and inactive; require at least 4.5 hours before the deadline and 25 GiB physical C: headroom. Otherwise record a time/capacity skip, without shortening the fixed game cap.
interpretation: This is the full fresh external comparison after correcting a proved reporting boundary, not retrospective rescoring. It may finish later this morning; the overall release/3500 objective remains active until directly supported by sufficient calibration.
stop_rules: Any operational, legal, capacity, deadline or failed-A/A interruption leaves the cell unscored. Preserve the original 400-game rejection and all frozen plans.
